original_issues.title: 子程序建立回應中斷可誤報停止
original_issues.finding: all_training_processes_exited在Popen回傳後才改False，try/finally更晚。若OS已建立child而取消發生在回應記錄前，外層可捕捉中斷卻保留原True，進而把未知child當已停止。
original_issues.counterexample: Popen fault fixture真建立一個sleep子程序後於回傳邊界注入KeyboardInterrupt；實際bounded_child返回時child仍活著，旗標True。把同旗標交實際finish_cpu（GitHub及ledger均明示fixtures）會得到failed-stopped。審閱者隨即kill+wait，已真確認此私有fixture child退出。
original_issues.required_resolution: 進入任何child建立邊界前先持久／內存保守標示未知，已取得handle則停止並wait；未知start或wait狀態不得變成verified stopped/failed-stopped。要以同反例回核，不只測已取得Popen物件後的deadline。

original_issues.observation: Talker verifies codec-selection recipe/weight/metadata SHA values but does not require a successful formal codec job-origin/job-result, fixed formal codec config or completed6000 updates. A real two-update development codec with K256/width32 and source_unchanged=true, no formal codec receipt and a matching selection JSON passes execute -> train -> actual load_trained and reaches the Talker training function.
original_issues.impact: Development or partial codec weights can become the supposedly formal frozen Talker target source. Current file fingerprints alone do not establish formal provenance.
original_issues.required: Before any Talker target creation, verify successful completed formal codec provenance bound to the same frozen recipe/data/metrics, exact required codec training config/update count and the selected weight/metadata SHA. Reject development,missing/failed/partial formal receipts and mismatched configs.
original_issues.boundary: Only checked_job audit admission was mocked in this prerequisite probe; the codec actually trained for two review-only updates, the real codec loader was used, and Talker training was replaced by a sentinel before optimizer work. Everything stayed under the private review directory.

original_issues.observation: Continuation checkpoints store config/optimizer/RNG/usage but do not bind the training implementation/revision. Three actual fresh processes in isolated source copies train two AV steps under A, continue two under B with an AV-forward behavior change, and compare fresh B four-step training. Cross-source resume succeeds, declares complete4/source_unchanged=true and all-B implementation hashes, and load_trained accepts it although parameters differ from fresh-B training.
original_issues.impact: The final metadata can misattribute old-source training history to the current freeze. The import-time/end-of-call checks only protect the resumed call and cannot recover the checkpoint origin.
original_issues.required: Bind checkpoint metadata to the actual training implementation/revision and continuation protocol/runtime as needed; verify it before resuming. Cross-source or incompatible historical checkpoints must reject rather than being relabeled as the current frozen run. Preserve complete origin/source lineage for any explicitly different research continuation.
original_issues.boundary: The only modified source was an isolated review copy. All three processes used tiny train/dev AV banks; neither repository implementation nor any formal/final output was changed.

original_issues.observation: When SIGALRM/alarm are unavailable, the driver writes job-origin and creates .formal-running, catches the first AttributeError, then finally calls missing signal.alarm again. That second AttributeError prevents job-result persistence and lock removal. A labeled private audit fixture exercised the actual checked_job gate before this failure; no training function was invoked.
original_issues.impact: Unsupported platforms such as Windows are not safely rejected before attempt mutation and can be left with a stale global lock plus no failure receipt.
original_issues.required: Either implement a real portable hard-deadline mechanism or explicitly reject unsupported alarm capability before creating attempt directories/locks. Cleanup/error persistence must not themselves call unavailable APIs; do not silently remove the deadline.

original_issues.observation: A same-source codec four-step run and two-plus-two resumed run have identical final parameters. With a constant dev score, the retained best is update1. Resuming latest-continuation.pt into a new directory completes4 updates but never writes weights.safetensors because no new score beats the old best; load_trained then raises KeyError for the missing file.
original_issues.impact: A complete resumed training receipt can be unusable for inference and the latest checkpoint does not by itself preserve the best model state required by the frozen earlier-checkpoint tie rule.
original_issues.required: Retain a SHA-bound best-state/artifact in the complete continuation protocol and re-export it on resume, or require and verify the complete accompanying best-artifact bundle before any resume updates. Never report a complete export without its selected weights, and do not reset best-selection history to hide the missing state.
